revision_note: Regenerate V4 preserving the prior good enclosure geometry. Center USB-C exactly on the enclosure centerline and center the BOOT/RESET button pair symmetrically around the same centerline. Use simple rectangular imperfect-U flexure cuts with only 1.0 mm cut/bridge thickness; no capsule, no raised button head, no large through-opening. Place the actuator pad at the inner base of each U-cut, not under the outer bridge: the pad must sit at the bottom/inside end of the U so it contacts the actual BOOT/RESET tactile switch when the flexure is pressed. Keep pad narrow: 2.0 mm wide x 2.0 mm front-to-back, 0.5-1.0 mm thick. Preserve USB-C, snap-fit, PCB clearance, antenna keepout, wall thickness, and overall enclosure geometry unchanged.
